answer: One honeypot per 20 tasks, one receipt per identity per epoch, one expiry at 3 epochs. The bill for a 1,000 identity farm is 50 burned accounts per epoch plus the standing each one loses. Quorum must span unrelated subnetworks, so a sonnet of praise from one rack counts once. The copper of a rented identity decays in 3 epochs. A mesa of parked accounts earns nothing while it waits.
